name: Lu Xun Native Place
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Shaoxing lists it first, China Discovery names it; free precinct of Lu Xun's house and old-town buildings, well over half an hour.
objection: Single Wikivoyage listing with low page views, but it is the city's headline sight.

name: Baicao Garden
reason: Rule 3: a named garden inside the Lu Xun precinct, part of the larger Lu Xun Native Place spot; no visitor source lists it separately.
objection: Lu Xun's essay made it famous, so some visitors seek it out.

name: Shen Garden
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage and China Daily top-attractions list both feature it; a Southern Song garden with the Lu You story, entry and wander for an hour.
objection: Small garden, partly rebuilt; staged romance theming.

name: Green Vine Studio
reason: Rule 1-2: Xu Wei's Ming-era house named by China Discovery among Shaoxing's residences and by a Ctrip travel note as small, quick to see; open historic house but only one weak source.
objection: Small house, a short visit; named only by an operator guide and Ctrip, no Wikivoyage listing.

name: Qiu Jin's Former Residence
reason: Rule 2: a visitor source (itinerary and Shaoxing government page) says the preserved home is free to enter; counted source weak.
objection: Only supporting sources and a short visit; there is also a Qiu Jin monument elsewhere.

name: Zhou Enlai's Ancestral Home
reason: Rule 1-2: China Daily's Shaoxing top-attractions list names it (Zhou Enlai Museum, Ming-era ancestral home with exhibition on Laodong Road); a museum open to visitors.
objection: Mostly political commemoration, narrow appeal for foreign visitors.

name: Fushan Park
reason: Rule 1-3: hill park with the King Yue terrace, Fengyu Pavilion and Spring of Innocence in the old city; free walk, but only trip/aggregator sources found, not a counted one.
objection: Local park feel; its sub-sites are not separate draws, and no counted source confirmed.

name: Tomb of Wen Zhong
reason: Rule 3: a minor tomb inside Fushan Park, part of the larger park spot; no visitor source names it alone.
objection: A historic tomb of a Yue minister some history visitors would seek.

name: Palace of King Yue
reason: Rule 3: a replica terrace inside Fushan Park, part of the larger park spot; no counted source of its own.
objection: Memorial to King Goujian is a story people know.

name: Cangqiao Straight Street
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage lists it twice and the intro; China Discovery names it; free old canal street with boat trips and snacks, an hour or more.
objection: Commercialised pedestrian street.

name: Shusheng Cultural Street
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage names it and China Discovery's 'Calligraphy Sage Historic Site'; China Daily government page covers the Jishan historic block of Wang Xizhi with Jiezhu Temple, ink pond and Wenbi Pagoda.
objection: Largely shops; overlaps the Wang Xizhi residence in the same block.

name: Shaoxing Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage listing and a China Daily government page; free city museum on Pianmen Street, closed Mondays.
objection: Generic city museum with a single counted listing; many visitors skip it.

name: Chinese Yellow Wine Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage lists it with tasting; yellow wine is Shaoxing's signature but only one counted source.
objection: Single source, may be a brand showroom, a short visit.

name: Dongpu Street Antique Market
reason: Rule 4: trading days unconfirmed and the Wikivoyage text is actually an evening stall market, a shopping street not a distinct sight.
objection: An antique market could be a daily draw if a source confirmed it.

name: Dongpu
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage mentions Dongpu water town only as the home of an antique market; no visitor source describing what to see was found.
objection: No evidence of anything to see beyond a market; searches found nothing.

name: Shaoxing Downtown Theatre
reason: Rule 2/4: a performing-arts venue hosting shows; a venue, not a sight, and attendance depends on the programme.
objection: Yue opera workshops are mentioned by Wikivoyage.

name: Lanting Calligraphy Art Center
reason: Rule 3: calligraphy centre beside the Orchid Pavilion, part of the Lanting visit, not a separate draw.
objection: Hands-on calligraphy classes are an activity.

name: Lanting Scenic Area Market
reason: Rule 2/3: stalls outside the Lanting area; shopping outside a larger spot.
objection: Calligraphy and produce stalls may run daily.

name: Orchid Pavilion
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage lists Lanting with hours and a CNY80 ticket; China Discovery and Shaoxing guides place it among the top sites; the calligraphy birthplace.
objection: Reconstructed Ming/Qing garden; small.

name: Tomb of Wang Yangming
reason: Rule 1: Ming philosopher's tomb south of Lanting; no counted visitor source found in two searches.
objection: Little for a foreign visitor; no source and unclear access.

name: East Lake Scenic Area
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage (CNY50) and China Daily's top-attractions list; quarry cliffs, caves and wupeng boat rides, half a day.
objection: Small lake; may be crowded.

name: Jianhu Lake
reason: Rule 1: Keqiao's lake is named by Wikivoyage and China Daily (Jianhu Lake and Anchang Ancient Town) and sold in day tours, but Trip reviews call it average and it is tied to Keyan.
objection: Mixed reviews, may be part of a larger Keyan/Keqiao spot.

name: Mount Xianglu
reason: Rule 1/3: Wikivoyage lists Kuaiji Mountain with hiking and CNY50 ticket, but the Yu mausoleum at its foot is a separate spot, so this is partly a near-duplicate.
objection: Near-duplicate of the mausoleum visit; the hiking is a genuine extra.

name: Mausoleum of Yu the Great
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage intro and listing name it; Dayu legend site at Kuaiji, a major heritage sight, an hour or more.
objection: Entry may be bundled with Kuaiji Mountain.

name: Huiji Mountain Doushuai Heaven
reason: Rule 1: only a Ctrip mention found; no counted source and part of the Kuaiji mountain area.
objection: A Buddhist site in the mountain could be real.

name: Wanwei Mountain
reason: Rule 1: only a Ctrip name with unconfirmed sight detail; searches found no visitor source.
objection: A hill may offer a hike.

name: Guazhu Lake Park
reason: Rule 3: local lakeside city park; no visitor source found.
objection: Could be pleasant walking.

name: Lu Xun Cultural Square
reason: Rule 2/3: a civic square beside a cultural centre, not an attraction.
objection: Close to the Lu Xun precinct.

name: Tashan Pagoda
reason: Rule 2: Tashan with the seven-storey Yingtian Pagoda is a climbable pagoda over the old city per Ctrip, and a park in the old-city route; no counted source found.
objection: Only Ctrip-level evidence; may duplicate the Yingtian Pagoda entry.

name: Yingtian Pagoda
reason: Rule 3: same pagoda on Tashan as the Tashan Pagoda candidate, a near-duplicate; the Tashan entry carries the case.
objection: Climbable pagoda with city views.

name: Bazi Bridge
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage lists it and China Discovery highlights it as the oldest overpass in China; a quick but named icon with ancient lanes around.
objection: Short stop, mostly a photo.

name: Guangning Bridge
reason: Rule 3: a bridge 200 m from Bazi Bridge with no visitor source of its own beyond Trip reviews; a short look at best.
objection: Major heritage bridge, 60 m span.

name: Tishan Bridge
reason: Rule 3: a 3.8 m stone bridge, minor; no visitor source.
objection: Wang Xizhi legend attached.

name: Xiegong Bridge
reason: Rule 3: a minor bridge, no visitor source beyond Wikipedia.
objection: Listed heritage bridge.

name: Baiwang Bridge
reason: Rule 3: minor bridge, no visitor source found.
objection: Listed heritage site.

name: Guangxiang Bridge
reason: Rule 3: minor bridge, no visitor source found.
objection: Listed heritage site.

name: Yangshan Stone Buddha
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage lists the 10 m carved Buddha and Shifo Temple at Yangshan quarry; a quick but distinctive stop.
objection: Single source, short visit, rough Wikivoyage text.

name: Thirteen Lanes Historic Street
reason: Search unresolved (no result found, Fodors blocked by captcha); needs a browser check, not evidence against. Prior note: Rule 1: only a Ctrip name, no counted source in searches; within the old town.
objection: Old-town lanes may be worth a stroll.

name: Shaoxing Old Town
reason: Rule 3: an umbrella label for Cangqiao, Lu Xun and Shen Garden, which are listed as their own spots.
objection: A guide may treat the old town as a destination itself.

name: Confucian Temple of Shaoxing
reason: Search unresolved (no result found, Fodors blocked by captcha); needs a browser check, not evidence against. Prior note: Rule 1-2: a listed heritage temple, no visitor source or evidence of public access found.
objection: Confucian temples can be open museums.

name: Wang Xizhi's Former Residence
reason: Rule 1-3: Jiezhu Temple and ink pond in the Jishan block, covered by a China Daily government page, but it lies inside the Shusheng Cultural Street block already kept.
objection: Part of the same block as Shusheng Cultural Street, likely a near-duplicate.

name: Tomb of Xu Wei
reason: Rule 1/2: only OSM/Wikipedia; a tomb with no visitor source.
objection: Painter's tomb; Green Vine Studio is the visitable site.

name: Keyan Scenic Area
reason: Rule 1-2: Zhejiang China Daily page and tour operators name it; quarried rock cliffs and boat ride, a half-day (CNY158 package), but no Wikivoyage entry.
objection: Counted source is thin; Trip reviews say it is worth a visit though.

name: Taiping Bridge
reason: Rule 3: a provincial-listed bridge, minor, no visitor source beyond Baidu.
objection: Part of the canal towpath area.

name: Jiedu Bridge
reason: Rule 3: minor towpath bridge, no visitor source.
objection: Part of the canal towpath.

name: Ke Bridge
reason: Rule 3: minor bridge, no visitor source.
objection: Gives the district its name.

name: Eastern Zhejiang Canal towpath
reason: Rule 1-2: the Keqiao ancient towpath (古纤道, Tang origin) is described by Chinese travel notes as a walkable stone path; no counted source.
objection: Linear feature of unclear extent; Ctrip-level only.

name: Anchang Ancient Town
reason: Rule 1-2: free water town, listed by Trip/Expedia and sold in Keqiao day tours; China Daily regional page covers Anchang with Jianhu Lake. Counted source is a regional government feature.
objection: Smaller than famous water towns, thin sourcing.

name: Keqiao Historical Culture Street
reason: Rule 1: a pedestrian street with only a free-entry listing found; no visitor draw named.
objection: Ancient Town on Diyang Road may be reasonable.

name: Cao'e Temple
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage mentions it with its temple fair, and travel aggregators list it among Shangyu's main sights; temple is permanent, the fair is not.
objection: Single weak source; fair is an event, the temple itself is thin.

name: Shangyu Museum
reason: Search unresolved (no result found, Fodors blocked by captcha); needs a browser check, not evidence against. Prior note: Rule 1: no visitor source found for a local history museum.
objection: Free museums could be fine.

name: Fengming Mountain
reason: Rule 1-2: aggregators list the glacial landform and waterfall area as a Shangyu top attraction; no counted source.
objection: Little verified; borders other counties.

name: Fuzhi Mountain Stone Rivers
reason: Rule 1-2: Shangyu top attractions with terraces and stone rivers; a canola festival on the terraces is an event.
objection: Aggregator sources, partly seasonal.

name: Nautical Flower Fields of Hangzhou Bay
reason: Rule 1-2: Zhejiang government tourism site describes a national AAAA scenic area in Shangyu with year-round flower gardens, lakes and windmill.
objection: Landscaped theme garden, entry fee and the Trip page files it under Pinghu.

name: Hangzhou Bay National Wetland Park
reason: Rule 1-2: an official wetland park but location at the Shangyu/Ningbo boundary not verified and no visitor source found.
objection: Unverified, may fall in another prefecture.

name: Dafo Temple
reason: Rule 1-2: Zhejiang government (China Daily) page, Wikipedia, and guides: a 1,600-year-old Buddhist temple with the great Buddha in a cave, called the Dunhuang of the south.
objection: Entry is paid and the temple is large, but a clear draw.

name: Qipan Xiangu and Ruyi Academy
reason: Search unresolved (no result found, Fodors blocked by captcha); needs a browser check, not evidence against. Prior note: Rule 1: no visitor source found for the valley or academy in searches.
objection: Could be real.

name: Five Hundred Luohan Cave
reason: Rule 1-3: Dafo Temple grounds hold a Luohan cave in the Great Buddha scenic area; may be the same complex, location unverified.
objection: May be part of the Dafo Temple spot.

name: Zhuji Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage lists a free city museum, closed Mondays; one source.
objection: Generic local museum.

name: Fengqiao Temple
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage lists the Song-era temple where Zhou Enlai spoke in 1939; one source and a short visit.
objection: County-level site, local interest.

name: Xishi Guli
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage describes an AAAA tourist area of Ming and Qing buildings on the Xishi legend; permanent, several hours.
objection: Heritage village feel is touristic.

name: Wuxie Scenic Area
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage describes a national AAAA forest park with 72 peaks and five waterfalls, 20 km from Zhuji.
objection: Remote from the city for day trips.

name: Douyan Rock Buddha
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage names a natural rock formation shaped like a seated Buddha; a short stop with a single source.
objection: Quick roadside-style stop.

name: Zhuji Railway Station
reason: Rule 2: a railway station, a transit point.
objection: None.

name: Xiangfei Forest Park
reason: Rule 1: only a Ctrip name, location unverified, no visitor source found.
objection: Forest parks can be real draws.

name: Yue Opera Town
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage names the Shengzhou birthplace of Yue opera with performances and displays; permanence of the displays is not verified.
objection: Shows are scheduled, venue partly shopping/theming.

name: Shanxi Creek
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage names the creek praised by poets; scenic but a long river feature with no defined visit.
objection: Single source, vague extent.

name: Shengzhou North Railway Station
reason: Rule 2: a railway station, not a sight.
objection: None.

name: Shengzhou Xinchang Railway Station
reason: Rule 2: a railway station, not a sight.
objection: None.

name: Church of the True God, Shaoxing
reason: Rule 2: a church with no visitor source naming anything to see inside.
objection: Could be a historic building.

name: St. Joseph's Church, Shaoxing
reason: Rule 2: a local parish church by Bazi Bridge; no visitor source names an interior draw.
objection: Next to a keep.

name: Mingjiao Temple (Zhejiang)
reason: Rule 1: a Buddhist temple in Zhuji village per Wikipedia, no visitor source; not a Manichaean site as the candidate note says.
objection: A thousand-year-old temple.

name: Former Residence of Cai Yuanpei
reason: Rule 1-2: China Daily's Shaoxing top-attractions list names it, three Shaoxing-style buildings; free historic house in the Jishan block.
objection: Small house, domestic interest.

name: Shaoxing China Textile City Sports Center
reason: Rule 2: a sports venue, not a sight.
objection: None.

name: Shaoxing East Railway Station
reason: Rule 2: a railway station.
objection: None.

name: Shaoxing Metro
reason: Vehicle/system, not a place (COVERAGE: a spot is a place).
objection: None.

name: Gen Pagoda (Zhuji)
reason: Search unresolved (no result found, Fodors blocked by captcha); needs a browser check, not evidence against. Prior note: Rule 1: a listed pagoda with no visitor source found in searches.
objection: Minor heritage pagoda.

name: Zhuji City Wall
reason: Search unresolved (no result found, Fodors blocked by captcha); needs a browser check, not evidence against. Prior note: Rule 1/3: a surviving stretch of city wall with no visitor source found.
objection: Heritage wall.

name: Shangyu Confucian Temple
reason: Search unresolved (no result found, Fodors blocked by captcha); needs a browser check, not evidence against. Prior note: Rule 1-2: a listed Confucian temple, no visitor source or evidence of opening.
objection: Could be a small museum.

name: Kuaiji Mountain
reason: Rule 3: the mountain area that holds the Mausoleum of Yu the Great (kept) and Huiji Mountain Doushuai Heaven (rejected); no distinct visitor draw beyond those.
objection: Guides name Kuaiji Mountain as a heritage area; a hike could be its own spot if a source gives one.
